# packages/protocol-rs

Rust generated protocol types. **Read-only — generated by `tools/codegen` from `packages/protocol/v1/*.schema.json`.**

## Do NOT edit

- Files under `src/v1/generated/` are codegen output. Edit the schema and re-run `bash scripts/codegen.sh` instead.
- `cargo fmt` is honored by the codegen.
- The header comment in each generated file is required (slice 45) and verified by `tools/codegen/MANIFEST.json` drift check.

## Tests

- `cargo test -p protocol-rs` — validates round-trip and manifest parity (slice 19, 25).
